crGraphBinary.notOnDefaultPath: It is NOT on the default shell PATH. To invoke it in Bash, prepend PATH: `export PATH="$HOME/Library/Python/3.12/bin:$PATH"` OR call the full path OR pass it via config.graph.codeReviewGraphPath.
crGraphBinary.note: NOTE: cr-graph 'init'/'install' is an MCP-registration alias, NOT a graph build. The graph is built with `build` (full) / `update` (incremental). So the backend's cliMap should map init->['build'] (or ['update','--brief']) and sync->['update', ...]. CONFIRM by reading `code-review-graph build --help` / `update --help` / `status --help` before wiring.
